notes: operator request 2026-10-19 (housekeeping batch): bl_land.py on 2026-10-19: 3441 lines, 122 commits in 30 days (the most churned module), every landing and close edits it. The cut follows its command groups (cmd_tidy/cmd_close at 2585-3125, cmd_precheck/cmd_researched at 474-628 and 3126-3369). Plan against SP-ipeewrlv, which changes tidy first. Premise: the first check fails. Checks 1, 2 (0-based) pass before the work on purpose: they pin behaviour that must stay (a gate, an eval, a guard test or a count that may not drop) beside the checks that fail until the work is done.
